svg.aria-label: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and Agentic AI: attack map and code-level defenses
svg.text: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & Agentic AI
Visual attack map and code-level defenses
dashed rose = untrusted · blue = policy enforcement
Also attacks from below: poisoned data, models, plugins & MCP servers → LLM04 · LLM05 · ASI04
Isolate untrusted text, classify inputs, strip output URLs
Redact PII before inference; ACL-filter retrieval
Least-privilege tool scopes; human approval for writes
Pin and verify models by hash/signature; keep an SBOM
Verify data provenance; quarantine new ingestion
Rate limits, token quotas, max agent loop depth
Ground answers in sources; cite and verify claims
Keep secrets out of prompts; assume context leaks
Tenant-scoped indexes; permission check at retrieval
Treat output as untrusted: validate schema, encode
agents that plan, remember and act
Pin goals; verify each plan against user intent
Allow-list tools; validate arguments against schema
Pin and sign tools, MCP servers and plugins
Run generated code in a sandbox or microVM
Validate memory writes; segment and expire memory
Circuit breakers, step limits, blast-radius isolation
Behavior monitoring with a tested kill switch
Assume the model will be fooled. Design so nothing important breaks.
